request: Create a new BB plugin named Agent Canvas based closely on the supplied reference screenshot. Build a full-screen dark spatial canvas with draggable/resizable live thread panes using native ThreadChat, a persistent Coordinator native chat docked on the right, a compact workspace tab strip and add control, dotted background, minimap, zoom/fit/reorganize controls, and pane title/status metadata. Coordinator selection or creation must be an explicit user action through native BB controls; never autonomously spawn or message agents. Use current public Plugin SDK surfaces, preserve authorization and permission modes, persist bounded canvas layout safely, provide keyboard and narrow-screen fallbacks, add the package to the workspace catalog, install/reload it locally, and verify the visual experience against the screenshot without copying AgentGrid branding or proprietary assets.
message: Removed right Control dock, selector, composer, toggle and pane assignment actions. Removed duplicate plugin title and compacted partial browser coverage into tab row. Full-width desktop and full-height narrow canvas retained. Existing conversations and backend identity/commands preserved. Typecheck/build passed; plugin reloaded. Live Playwright confirmed absent dock/control buttons and 1280px full canvas width plus 764px narrow canvas height; screenshot inspected. Unit suite and formal review pending. English implementation commit fa98f2c2; target sync current with main.
